title: log_session_broken
description: Open/close sentinel: the previous logging session was broken (e.g. a LIFO open/close violation or an unclosed session) and its records were discarded at flush. A flush containing this scope contains ONLY it — the wiped session's entries are gone, so the cache activity of that window is unknown, not "no cache activity". The next session logs normally.

reason.description: The throwable message (or class) that broke the session
